Shenzhen’s HexaCore Electronics Unveils Advanced AI-Integrated Server Platform

HexaCore Electronics, a leading provider of enterprise technology solutions in China, has announced the launch of its new AI-integrated server platform, the HC-9000, at an event held in Shenzhen on Tuesday. The release marks HexaCore’s latest move to address growing demand for high-performance computing infrastructure within China’s rapidly expanding technology hardware sector.

The HC-9000 is equipped with HexaCore’s proprietary X-Logic processor, designed to accelerate artificial intelligence workloads for data centers, cloud computing providers, and research institutions. According to the company, the new servers deliver a 40% improvement in computational throughput over previous models, while reducing energy consumption by 15%.

“China’s digital transformation is driving unprecedented requirements for intelligent infrastructure,” said Wei Liang, Chief Product Officer at HexaCore Electronics. “With the HC-9000, we aim to empower organizations to deploy scalable AI solutions with industry-leading efficiency.”

Industry analysts note that the launch comes as Chinese enterprises and public sector organizations increase investments in digitalization and automation. “HexaCore’s move reinforces the broader trend of domestic hardware manufacturers prioritizing AI capabilities,” said Yang Bo, senior analyst at Asia Technology Review. “The HC-9000’s performance metrics position it competitively against international offerings and underscore China’s commitment to technological self-sufficiency.”

The server platform will be manufactured at HexaCore’s Guangdong facility, which has recently expanded to meet surging demand. Local trade groups have welcomed the initiative, citing the potential for new business opportunities across the supply chain. “This launch strengthens the hardware ecosystem in southern China and supports further innovation in the sector,” commented Lin Shuwei, Secretary-General of the Shenzhen Technology Hardware Association.

HexaCore plans to begin shipping the HC-9000 to domestic customers by the end of June, with international availability scheduled for later this year. The company is also offering integration support services and training programs for clients adopting the new platform.

The HC-9000 launch highlights the ongoing evolution of China’s technology hardware industry, as companies leverage new AI technologies to enhance competitiveness and meet the needs of a digital economy.
